subject.title: feat: play ordered track URI lists

question: Should `spogo play` permanently accept multiple track arguments and expose ordered-list playback across every engine adapter?
rationale: This adds a public CLI capability and cross-engine contract rather than repairing established broken behavior, so implementation quality alone cannot establish product acceptance.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Accept variadic `play` after successful ordered-play proof and removal of the release-owned changelog entry.

options.title: Keep single-item play
options.body: Decline the new surface and keep ordered batches expressed through playlists or repeated queue operations.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Accept variadic `play` after successful ordered-play proof and removal of the release-owned changelog entry.

likelyOwner.reason: The available playback and release history makes this person the strongest routing candidate for the CLI product decision.
